key_insight: Repeated-sampling objectives such as pass@k and max@k can reduce sharpening by shifting learning pressure toward harder prompts, and standard single-completion objectives can reproduce their optimal policies.
engineering_relevance: KAPPO adapts existing policy optimizers to repeated-sampling objectives without otherwise changing training procedures, enabling control over behavioral coverage at lower sampling cost.
method: Derive closed-form optimal policies for KL-regularized pass@k and max@k.
Reproduce those optima using prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation.
Apply KAPPO after a one-time reference calibration.
evidence_signal: Experiments with several RL methods on mathematical reasoning and code generation report sharpening control and single-completion training that matches multi-completion @k optimizer performance at a fraction of the cost.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify calibration overhead or cost savings, so deployment-specific efficiency needs validation.
